sections.heading: Nerve Supply
paragraphs: The lateral compartment of the leg is supplied by the superficial fibular nerve (superficial peroneal nerve).

sections.heading: Blood Supply
paragraphs: Its proximal and distal arterial supply consists of perforating branches of the anterial tibial artery and fibular artery.
